caption: A downed power line lies in a wet street, and it sparks and jumps where its broken end touches the ground.

sa.check: A power line lies down in a wet street.
Its broken end touches the ground.
Sparks flash at the point of contact.
The cable end jumps or twitches.
The sparks and the jumps come in bursts rather than steadily.

pc.expect: The sparks flash in bursts at the broken end where it meets the ground, each burst brief and gone; they stay at the contact point.
pc.fail: The sparks travel down the street along the ground away from the cable end; or the cable's whole length glows; or a spark stays lit at one spot for the rest of the clip; or sparks appear from an intact part of the cable away from the broken end.

pc.expect: The cable end twitches or jumps with each burst and lies still between bursts; the rest of the cable moves only where dragged by the end.
pc.fail: The cable end jumps while no spark is flashing and no burst has just ended; or the cable slithers along the street steadily like a snake; or the end jumps up and hangs in the air; or the cable moves away from the sparks while the sparks stay behind.

pc.expect: Spark fragments fly out and fall to the wet ground, going dark within a short distance; the cable end falls back after each jump.
pc.fail: Sparks rise steadily and gather above the cable; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the ground for the rest of the clip; or the cable end stays in the air after a jump.

pc.expect: The wet street mirrors each burst briefly around the contact point.
pc.fail: The sparks flash while the wet street around them stays as dark as before; or a reflection lies far from the cable end; or the reflection stays lit after the burst is gone.

pc.expect: One cable with one broken end; it stays a continuous cable and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The cable splits into more pieces; or a second broken end appears; or the cable passes into the street surface; or the cable vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cable's colour, the street markings and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The cable changes colour or thickness; or the street markings change; or buildings or cars around change.
